news.summary: If you've been on gaming Twitter at all over the last month, you're probably aware of a massive wave of people

content.v: https://assets1.ignimgs.com/2021/03/01/halo-cortana-1614607712316.jpg

If you've been on gaming Twitter at all over the last month, you're probably aware of the massive wave of people using AI to rapidly decompile, port, and remix games. That wave of AI decomps has forced a massive decompilation community to sunset.

In a blog post, admin @encounter from decomp.dev , a community repository for people to track decompilation posts, cites a wave of bad actors who are using AI to essentially steal the hard work of programmers working on existing decompilation projects.

The act of decompiling games itself isn't new, and people have been taking games and trying to decompile them down to the source code for years. But what was once a herculean task requiring coding expertise can now be done with little effort thanks to new AI models like GPT 6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5.

The blog post doesn't blame the models themselves for the surge of vibe-coded decompilations and ports, but rather claims that bad actors are taking existing projects and then using AI to rush them to completion. While there might be some developers who are open to people with a Claude subscription using their work to create, say, a browser port of Halo , that should be up to each developer.

The post says, "Every project works differently: some may not want to use AI for legal or ethical reasons, and others may be okay with AI, or use AI themselves, but do not want drive-by contributions from folks who have put no effort into making sure the contributions are good. The bottom line is that these kinds of hostile forks put little to no effort into meaningfully contributing to existing projects, tearing apart our community fabric."

As for the ports themselves, the blog claims that people are taking the code from hobbyists and forcing a barely functioning port out of them. "While community members put in the effort to decompile a game, opportunists have frequently raced to release a half-baked, barely-functional port from it," @encounter writes.

The blog post also mentions that this recent wave of AI decomps, recomps, and ports is muddying the waters of what the decomp community is trying to do. A lot of classical decomps are done out of the love of games and a desire to know how they work, but this trend of using AI to brute force working PC ports has caused a lot of people to rush into communities like decomp.dev looking for simple ways to create easy PC ports of games.
As for decomp.dev itself, the website will still exist, and users can use it to track existing projects, but @encounter is taking down the main index and disabling new projects.

Unfortunately, when it comes to Opus 5.5, Astra 6, and decomps, the cat is out of the bag, and it's unlikely that one decomp repository going offline is going to meaningfully stop this trend. We've seen everything from making Minecraft playable on X/Twitter to modders shoving Minecraft and Elden Ring together . There have also been a lot of browser ports, with games like Halo: Combat Evolved and Grand Theft Auto 5 being briefly playable on Chrome before those games' respective publishers predictibly brought them crashing down.

Either way, it's a shame to see a community built out of the love of programming essentially die off because a bunch of people with Claude subscriptions are using game developers' work as a starting point and finishing it with AI.

news.title: K/DA 在“Start a Fire”回归之前将获得一本路易威登官方艺术书
news.titleEn: K/DA Is Getting an Official Louis Vuitton Art Book Ahead of 'Start a Fire' Comeback

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/15/kdavuitton-1792083048684.jpg
Riot Games has teamed up with fashion house Louis Vuitton on a K/DA Travel Book. The book’s reveal comes just after the League of Legends girl group announced their return from a six-year hiatus.

Tempo Point will collect new illustrations of the virtual girl group, envisioning “24 hours within the individual lives of K/DA members Ahri (vocalist), Akali (rapper), Evelynn (vocalist), and Kai’Sa (vocalist and lead dancer/choreographer).” A Standard edition and Collector’s edition will be released online and in select Louis Vuitton locations and bookstores on Friday, October 16.

The Louis Vuitton Travel Books are a series of premium artbooks, compiling images and illustrations from artists around the world. This particular addition to the collection will be available in two formats: a Standard Edition ($68 USD) and a Collector’s Large-Format Edition ($245 USD). Both editions feature the same artwork in six-color printing, collected in a cloth-bound hardcover book with a silk-screened cover.

Only 400 copies are being printed of the Collector's Edition, which will be available for purchase online on Louis Vuitton’s website , at Louis Vuitton stores, and in select bookstores. The Standard Edition will be available from the same places, and will also be shown off at the upcoming League of Legends Worlds 2026 Fan Fest event scheduled for November 12 to 14 in New York.
Select Louis Vuitton stores will also have limited-edition signed copies that come with an exclusive vinyl record. Only 30 total copies of this edition will be available.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/15/kda2-1792083039463.jpg
虽然路易威登似乎有点随意，但这家法国时装屋实际上一直是 Riot Games 和虚拟女团的一贯合作者。
2019 年，该品牌成为联盟世界锦标赛召唤师杯奖杯箱的官方提供商。品牌女装系列艺术总监 Nicolas Ghesquière 为《英雄联盟》设计了多款皮肤，在《MORE》的宣传活动中，品牌还为 K/DA 和客座艺术家 Lexie Liu（为 Seraphine 配音）设计了服装。
K/DA 是一个虚拟流行乐队，于 2018 年以单曲 POP/STARS 首次亮相，刚刚预告了他们自 2020 年以来的首次回归。新项目是通过发布在 K/DA 社交帐户上的一张图片来揭晓的，展示了每个成员的眼睛和口号“Start a Fire”。完整的项目将于 10 月 20 日公布。
Fortiche 一直在各种社交平台上与 K/DA 官方公告进行互动，这表明 Arcane 工作室可能已经制作了一部新的 K/DA 音乐视频。

news.title: 007 First Light On Switch 2 Includes Something No Other Platform Gets, And It’s Ridiculous
news.summary: IO Interactive has announced the release date for 007 First Light's long-delayed Switch 2 version--March 18, 2

content.v: IO Interactive has announced the release date for 007 First Light's long-delayed Switch 2 version--March 18, 2027--and that's not all. People who preorder the game for Switch 2 are getting something no other platform has: a ridiculously oversized tie.

Not just any ridiculously oversized tie, however. People who preorder First Light for Switch 2 get the GoldenEye Suit, and it includes the suit and tie that Pierce Brosnan wore in the famous 1995 movie, including the oversized tie.
Brosnan wore a lot of suits in that movie, but the one being referenced here is the one with the oversized tie, which was the style at the time.

GoldenEye has a special history with Nintendo specifically, which may help explain why Switch 2 owners are getting this outfit and no one else is. After all, 1997's GoldenEye 007, which was based on the movie, is one of the most iconic N64 games of all time.
First Light has been a big hit, critically and commercially, scoring great reviews and selling more than 4 million copies , and that's before the Switch 2 version even comes out.
The Switch 2 version of First Light was supposed to launch alongside the other versions in May 2026, but was later delayed multiple times. IO said a combination of factors contributed to delays.

In addition to the forthcoming Switch 2 version of First Light, IO is working on a new fantasy game. However, after Xbox pulled funding, IO laid off staff. Many also want to see IO work on the expected sequel to First Light , but no official announcements have been made.

news.title: CD Projekt 已正式开始 Project Hadar，但尚未进入预制作阶段
news.summary: CD Projekt Red, the Polish developer best known for its amazing RPG series The Witcher and Cyberpunk 2077, has

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/15/cd-projekt-new-building-018-1792084979426.jpeg

CD Projekt Red, the Polish developer best known for its amazing RPG series The Witcher and Cyberpunk 2077 , has officially finished imagining up a new world for us to play in. The “world vision” stage for its new IP, Project Hadar, has been completed and work has officially begun on turning those concepts into a video game.

"This has been our biggest undertaking to date, taking us several years, but at this point we can say we have a coherent vision for this world and its key elements,” said Joint CEO Michał Nowakowski . “The team has begun work on the game, although it's not yet in pre-production.”

In September, CD Projekt Red said it was staffing up for Project Hadar, with a team over 30 strong with plans "to hire more, up to 50 developers by the end of this year. But what is it? In June, a new job advert teased what to expect , calling for an engineering director who would help “push the envelope for the next, immersive game in the Hadar world, creating an emotional, open-world experience that will stay with gamers.” Open-world confirmed!

CD Projekt Red is of course currently hard at work making The Witcher 4, which is the next game on the studio’s slate due out 2028. Before that, though, a third major expansion for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt, titled Songs of the Past, is scheduled for release next year. Developed by Fool’s Theory, a team of former CD Projekt developers, the expansion aims to bridge the gap between The Witcher 3 and the next game in the series, starring Geralt’s adopted daughter, Ciri.

After that comes Cyberpunk 2, the follow-up to Cyberpunk 2077. And let's not forget that CD Projekt intends to release the new The Witcher 3 trilogy in the space of six years. Assuming CD Projekt hits 2028 for The Witcher 4, and the company sticks to its ambitious release strategy for this new The Witcher trilogy , we could see The Witcher 5 in 2031 and The Witcher 6 in 2034. Where Hadar fits in with all that is anyone's guess.

We know nothing about Project Hadar’s world or setting, but it’ll be cool to see what the wonderful minds at CDPR think up — especially as it’ll be designed first and foremost to support a sprawling RPG. I do selfishly wish CDPR would do one more license though. Give us a good Game of Thrones video game. Please. You could call it Project Hodor.

The next series of the anime based on CDPR and Pondsmith’s shared world is coming to Netflix on October 20. You can check out our interview with the creator of Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 for the lowdown.

Elsewhere in CD Project Land, The Witcher 3 just got a remaster on consoles and PC, which saw the iconic RPG get a makeover to tide people over until the expansion. There were some issues with the new visuals, particularly heavy bloom in The Witcher 3 remaster , but CDPR fixed its prized goose sharpish.

content.v: Ahead of the Street Fighter movie 's release this week, 2K Games has announced a new DLC pack for WWE 2K26 that lets you dress several WWE performers as Street Fighter action figures .

You can make the likes of Rey Mysterio and The Rock look like oversized toys, and each version of the WWE star will also come equipped with Street Fighter-inspired moves like the Shinku Hadoken, Psycho Crusher, Spiral Arrow, Electric Thunder, and Shoryuken. Pricing hasn't been revealed yet, but generally, these character packs cost around $15.
Available starting October 28 as a standalone purchase--and not included in any existing bundles or premium editions of the game--the WWE 2K26 X Street Fighter Elite Pack includes:

Strangely, there's no Cody Rhodes Street Fighter skin, which is kind of weird since he plays Guile in the movie and has even cosplayed as him at WWE live events. Additionally, the pack includes 15 Create-a-Superstar parts from several other Street Fighter characters: Akuma, Vega, and Chun-Li. Reviews have also begun appearing online for Street Fighter, and on GameSpot's sister site Metacritic , the film has a "mixed or average" metascore of 46 from 19 reviews. Critics say that the movie's story is an absolute mess, and it's barely held together by several stylish fight scenes across its two-hour runtime.
The movie isn't tracking well for its opening weekend either , as current estimates suggest that it could struggle to make a dent at the box office. At least popcorn bucket sales should be a hit.

news.title: 世嘉因 AI 升级图形引发强烈反对而下架《全面战争：幕府将军 2 重制版》
news.summary: Following player backlash, Sega and Creative Assembly have yanked Total War: Shogun 2 - Complete Edition from

content.v: Following player backlash, Sega and Creative Assembly have yanked Total War: Shogun 2 - Complete Edition from sale and have replaced it with the original 2011 version. First hitting digital shelves on October 13, this version of the beloved strategy game was advertised as having had a substantial facelift, but it wasn't long before players pointed out numerous issues with the game and the telltale sign of AI-upscaling. This has led to some bizarre makeovers, like a samurai's face merging with his helmet or extra fingers on character artwork.

"We're aware that Total War: Shogun 2 - Complete Edition has fallen short of both your expectations and our own standards," Sega wrote in a statement that did not address the AI criticisms at all. "We've seen your feedback, comments, and reviews. We agree that the current experience is not where it needs to be."

Fans have also taken to social media to show off legacy bugs that still haven't been addressed in this new edition, and Sega said that it's "working closely" with its "development partners" to identify and address these issues. Unsurprisingly, the game has an overwhelmingly negative rating on Steam currently, with over 81% of players urging people to give it a skip.

"Horrific graphical bug makes the vegetation in battle map terrible to look at. There's no way to disable the vegetation," one oddly specific player review reads," amongst hundreds of other negative pieces of feedback.

Players also weren't happy when Sega initially replaced the original Shogun 2 game with the remastered version, which has a price tag of $40. Upgrading from the classic to this version will cost you $10. The AI-upscaling is just the tip of the complaints-iceberg, as players have several other issues with Shogun 2. The new user interface has been criticized for its clunky design and plenty of new bugs have surfaced. This isn't the only game using generative AI that Sega is linked to, as for the upcoming Crazy Taxi: World Tour, generative AI was used to create background assets.

news.summary: Three new Wolverine Funko Pops, based on Insomniac's latest game, are up for preorder with a release date of A

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/15/wolverine-funko-pop-preorder-1792076300072.jpg

Marvel's Wolverine is officially joining the Funko Pop lineup next year. Three new figures are now available to preorder - a mini model of Wolverine , one of Logan , and another of Omega Red - for $14.99 a piece. However, you'll have to wait a little while before you can add them to your collectible shelf, as they're slated to be released next year on April 18.
Preorder Wolverine Funko Pops

While that release date is still many months away from now, it's worth it to preorder your preferred model ahead of time, just in case they sell out. They certainly look like fun figures to have around if you're a fan of the game, too, and measure just under four inches tall so they won't take up much space.

For fans of Insomniac's latest looking for even more Wolverine goodies to buy, there's also an original soundtrack vinyl available to preorder right now, and the wait for that one isn't quite as long as the Funkos. This bright translucent yellow vinyl is set to drop in a couple months time on December 11, which is perfect timing if you're hoping to grab it as a gift for a Wolverine fan for the holidays, too.

And if you're on the hunt for even more Funko figures to add to your collectibles, there's plenty to look forward to that are set to release this year. Sticking within the realm of Marvel, new Avengers: Doomsday figures were recently announced which are set to drop sometime in November ahead of the film's release, so it's worth keeping an eye out for those.

Of course, there's also Black Friday right around the corner , which is a great opportunity to find figures at a discount. These sales kick off around the middle of November, so it won't be long before you can see what collectible discounts pop up.

news.title: GTA 6 发布预告片中的 33 个新细节
news.summary: GTA 6's launch trailer may only be 90 seconds long, but there's plenty to see - here's the 33 details we spott

others.title: 我们在 GTA 6 发布预告片中注意到的 10 件事

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/15/gta-launch-details-blog-1792081847737.jpg

Yet another look at GTA 6 has come our way, which means it’s time to get forensic; we’ve gone through the new trailer with a fine-tooth comb to pick out all of the interesting details hidden within. From peeks at what’s in store for some of its most explosive missions, further insights into Jason’s military past, and more than one visit to a steamy shower, there’s plenty of new things to take a look at.
Let’s not waste any more time. Here are the 33 details we spotted in the GTA 6 launch trailer.

Multiple shots offer a closer look at Jason and paint a pretty clear picture of the kind of man we’ll be taking control of. We already knew that he was ex-military, but midway through the trailer we see him wearing a U.S. Army T-shirt that offers more details on his service.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/15/1-1792081397126.jpg

1. Firstly, the combat training school Jason seemingly trained at is located in North Fort Law. Longtime fans will recognise this as the military base from the very first Grand Theft Auto game. In that original game, it was located in the state of New Guernsey, but it’s more likely that the one Jason attended is in the State of Alderney, the HD universe’s take on New Jersey. We know that Lucia is from Liberty City, which is located in the neighboring State of Liberty – perhaps they met when Jason was stationed at the base?

2. More prominent than that small print is the word “Marauder,” which matches the skull-and-parachute tattoo on Jason’s arm that we’ve seen in previous videos. The Marauders are presumably the unit he served in, and may be a reference to the real-life Merrill's Marauders, a 1940s special forces group. Its modern-day equivalent is the 75th Ranger Regiment, and so it’s likely that Jason was a ranger.

3. It seems like Jason has fallen on tough times since he left the forces. “I got in some trouble in the army, didn’t leave on the best of terms,” he says in the trailer’s opening. “They don’t give loans, anything, to people like me.” With a situation like that, it’s no wonder Jason has resorted to crime. The cost of living is only going up!
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/15/2-1792081421431.jpg

4. Thankfully, it seems like Jason’s experience in the Marauders has equipped him with all the tools for a very fruitful life of crime. We see him wading through water dressed in special forces-like infiltration gear, a pair of night-vision goggles on his head and a silenced assault rifle in his hands. He’s accompanied by two other men, and the trio seem to have disembarked from a boat. While the blush night sky certainly looks very Floridian (or should we say Leonidan), an odd reptile to the left of the scene appears to be a komodo dragon, which is native to Indonesia. Is this a flashback to a mission from Jason’s army days? Or is the reptile simply a native of Leonida’s wetlands, and Jason has perhaps called on some former squadmates to help with some kind of job?

5. Much of the criminal work we see committed across this trailer has something of a military feel to it. We later see Jason on a helicopter, dressed in a bulletproof vest and demonstrating a very professional demeanor. He’s joined by a dog, potentially pointing to not just Jason having a pet, but also being able to use them as some kind of working dog. Later shots also show Jason confidently disembarking a chopper and checking the chambered round in his rifle – all small details, but ones that help paint the picture of a deeply competent professional.

6. Lucia may not have Jason’s highly trained background, but it looks like she’ll eventually adopt at least some of his tactics. A minute into the trailer, we can see her dressed in special forced black and equipped with a Shrewsbury rotary grenade launcher, popping explosives into pursuing police vehicles.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/15/3-1792081441492.jpg

7. She’s demolishing those cars from on high, hanging from the side of some kind of cargo net. A few seconds later, we see a helicopter carrying a giant load in a very similar cargo net – it seems likely that these shots are taken from the same mission, and that Lucia will hang from the net before or after it’s been dragged through the side of a skyscraper.

8. The damage caused by the crash is more detailed than anything we’ve seen in prior GTA games, with hundreds of shards of glass erupting from the side of the building. While this shot alone is far from confirmation that the game will feature Battlefield-like destruction tech, it is a flashy insight into just how detailed Rockstar is able to make environmental demolition.

9. That kind of collateral damage is to be expected from crime on the scale that GTA typically depicts, and it seems like this game has no intention of being smaller than GTA 5’s biggest moments. We can see Lucia leaping off a car onto a commercial liner, suggesting something on the same scale as some of Trevor’s airborne antics. This shot is likely the precursor to the scene in the second trailer that shows Lucia fighting in a plane’s hold as its landing gear deploys.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/15/4-1792081458953.jpg

10. The aforementioned chopper mission is probably a heist, but what’s definitely a heist is the bank job we see. This is actually the vault we previously saw in a screenshot we exclusively debuted back in August , complete with the burning bank notes and Lucia with her hair in a ponytail.

11. For that shot, Lucia is joined not by Jason but by another anonymous character. We can’t see their face, but whoever they are, it looks like we won’t be alone when conducting heists. In a later shot we see Lucia accompanied by gunmen disguised as construction workers, suggesting we’ll often be joined by crews of criminals. But will these be supporting characters introduced as part of the story, or NPCs hired to help, akin to how heist crews worked in GTA 5?

12. While stealing physical money is a tried and tested form of securing dosh, there’s a chance that GTA 6 will toy with a more decentralised approach, too. We see a bi-plane flying over Vice City’s beach, its side emblazoned with the logo for “DacityCoin.” That’s presumably some kind of Bitcoin parody, but why is it so prominent in the trailer? Why is there a guy hanging onto the plane’s wing and deploying a bright pink smoke flare? Our theory is that Jason and Lucia will take part in some kind of scam, and this is a stunt to advertise a bogus cryptocurrency.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/15/5-1792081479051.jpg
13. Planes aren’t the only high-speed thrills on show. A little later we see street racing, a side activity we first saw in August’s extended look.

14. Of course, most of GTA’s high-speed driving tends to be a race against the cops. A short car chase sequence sees one of our protagonists behind the wheel of a lime green supercar, fleeing police that arrive from all angles. It seems like every new trailer shows off new cars, and we get a very quick peek at the new Invetero Coquette, which can be glimpsed for a split second – look out for its turquoise-and-pink synthwave paint job.

15. For those who prefer waves to asphalt, you might find more joy in the Shasa, which appears to be a new model of boat for GTA 6. We can see Jason and his buddy Cal working on one, buffing out the paintwork. This seems to be Jason’s reality at the start of the story – with his army days behind him, he’s working as a laborer at Brian’s Marina.

一颦一笑或是孩子气，一言一行尽是赤诚心。
现在还是“傲娇”的版本吗？
作为一个老二次元，我时常有点拿不准。傲娇角色的举动是如此统一：双手抱在胸前，把头扭向一边，用略带怒意的语气否定自己对你有多中意，一旦被戳穿又急到满脸通红，再羞涩地微微袒露自己的内心。
后面随着与主角的羁绊加深，这种口是心非的性格也渐渐淡去，只剩满满的依赖……
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14508/ec7491978b3cd201d70c879c30bb212f.appmsg_mw680water
停，我们先打住。毕竟这是独属于虚构角色的表现手法，现实中如果有人做出此等举动，大概率会显得何其别扭不自然。唯独放在屏幕中，这种特质才能自然地存在于角色身上，还能反衬出一种可爱劲儿。
作为最经典的二次元人设之一，“傲娇”似乎总在“时代的眼泪”和“版本T0”之间来回横跳：偶尔会有人感慨这套已经不流行了，后脚遇到一个对胃口的角色，又觉得果然还是这个好。
但总之，随着时代更迭，这类角色比过去少见了很多，但一旦有个中意的，便会再次催生出“傲娇永不退环境”的口号。比如《明日方舟：终末地》 登场 的祀， 就 又激起了人们对“傲娇”的热情。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14508/77d665af6051e68f0448f3334e9694ba.appmsg_mw680water
网友看此前版本剧情的感受
在之前的剧情里，一直在幕后暗中相助主角一行人的巨兽代理人祀，终于现出了她在人世间的模样——一个看上去机敏狡黠的少女，言辞带有几分傲气，处处出手相助主角一行人，还对管理员说不清地偏爱有加。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14508/fe645896b1cb24ca78d46da8fc6d6ad0.gif_mw680
造型也以绿色为基调，大家也惯称其是“小葱”
到了今天 新版本 「丹青渡」正式上线后，有关祀的每一个细节，立刻成了社区最为热门的鉴赏内容，借用我看到最多的感叹来评价，就是“终末地实在太会写傲娇了”。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14508/ad94e95ed3250154941d6a7586794b9f.appmsg_mw680water
在我通关之前，我确实还挺好奇，终末地会如何去写与祀同游的故事。
毕竟之前 初见祀的时候 ，正值大战高潮，祀的傲娇反差出场不多，更多像剧情剑拔弩张氛围下的一抹调剂，让玩家一想到就觉得有趣、放松，因此观感很好。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14508/cb73f33411a919ac56c602dac2565769.appmsg_mw680water
如今在另一个大容量的故事中，当傲娇角色成了整个故事的核心 之一 ，终末地要如何把握“傲与娇”之间的平衡？傲娇角色最后的蜕变，又该怎么描绘才能让人心悦诚服？
我猜 终末地 或许会懂，但没想到它能这么懂。
其实在聊剧情如何刻画祀之前，终末地能把“傲娇的祀”带到台前，不让人觉得突兀，本身仰仗 绵长 的世界观铺垫。
一个角色的“傲气”能让人觉得自然，往往少不了相关联的身世、成长环境等设定，例如是名门望族或能力出众等。
祀的设定显然在此之上，她是巨兽代理人 ，换句话说， 站在大部分人的视角来说祀就像是“天上仙”，这种强大不以人的意志所更改，也不为任何阶级判定所影响，给了祀天生可以“傲”的合理之处。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14508/eacf674a0c40cc4841f973b137b3ec95.gif_mw680
倘若你像我一样 知晓岁家 ，领略过夕小妹、望二哥等人的性格 之后 ，那对祀的脾气 可能会有多么“古怪” ，其实都能有心理准备。
结果，来到大家 眼前的祀 ，是位矜持与稚气兼有的活泼少女。放在舟的世界观里，巨兽代理人此前不受炎国信任，长期处于高压监管之下，不容有太多喜悲、想法，更别提轻易出手干涉世间。
然而来到塔卫二， 祀能像个正值芳华的少女一样，偶尔向世人展露一点小性子，本身已然就是一种巨大的反差——相比于其他作品想搬出有个性的角色，要费尽心思去解释这种合理性，终末地属于是赢在了起跑线。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14508/79a194e0f314357ccc6a02ac36b67c45.appmsg_mw680water
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14508/7afc67d2a8f5443d187354124f70c228.appmsg_mw680water
背面还藏了个小蝴蝶结
但，即便你对这段过往不了解也没关系，毕竟当你看到一位天神般的少女，在面对你时突然降低了语调，摆弄着衣带问你有什么想对她说的，我感觉即便是一块木头，也能一眼看出来她对你的好感。
祀对管理员的这份偏爱，也成功地吊起了大家的好奇心。毕竟不妨想象一下，就好像你和朋友们逛街偶然遇到一位大明星，其他人只能远远地望上人家一眼，结果这位大明星看到你反倒径直走来，向你抱怨怎么能“忘了我”。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14508/6189fb2eb6c9bfee4ad0fc345492668b.appmsg_mw680water
皱着小脸靠近，萌之
这样的一场邂逅，在玩家心间也留下了棉花糖味的疑惑：她到底是谁？管理员与她之间又有过怎样的邂逅？
其实谈起傲娇会没落，也是因为观众、玩家的审美都在不断 地变化 ，对社交的理解也有所迭代，大家 似乎 开始更中意 直球的 “真诚” ，反倒觉得拐弯抹角不够坦率 。像是“傲娇”这种本身就自带几分别扭的性格，如果把握不好力度，很容易演变成一种令人生厌的刻薄。
也正因如此，终末地中祀“傲”的一面其实表现得相当克制。
有玩家为了证明这一点，甚至直接做了数据统计来论证：祀在之前 「向渊行」版本 里出场时，一半的台词都以流露关心为主，只有不到一成的台词显出了几分傲气。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14508/0c3feb98453dfdaf932f4c1cbe75764b.appmsg_mw680water
“傲娇学家”的钻研精神
这些所谓的“傲”也都如此柔和，丝毫不会有贬低他人的不适。甚至祀此前说过最有攻击性的词是一句“呆货”，就像一位久居世外导致语言版本落后的老神仙会说的词，但结合祀少女的容貌，又有了一种孩子气的反差感。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14508/7a419ffd5d8b82a44745e05fe877d803.appmsg_mw680water
在丹青渡的剧情里，这份“傲”则有了更为多维的描绘。如果概括来说其中的精髓，就是祀的“傲”或许会是一份狡辩，或许是一份小小的自满，但她绝不会刁难、苛责管理员。
另一方面，“傲娇”作为一种不坦率的属性，不可避免地要写到一种自我矛盾感——又想表达自己的内心又总是遮遮掩掩。
如果用文字描述出来，既仗着彼此之间的信任对你耍小性子，但下一秒又怕自己越界，明明两人是如此亲昵，但自己却会不自信，怕对面误解了自己。在这样自我的一拉一扯之间，最终反倒搞得满眼都是你。
在某个瞬间，祀会随口埋怨你一下，但一听管理员认真地道了歉，反倒一下又觉得自己言重了，又想到眼前的你并非过去的 “你” ，顿觉后悔；
这段人物微表情的演出也保持了细腻感
而当你意识到，管理员作为一个失去记忆的人，其实也为祀的“傲娇”又添了几分微妙的发展——不论你变成什么样，都并不妨碍祀对你的偏袒。在管理员 “施法过度” 晕厥在地后，祀瞬时变得手足无措不知接下来如何是好，之前的游刃有余，之前还在努力维持的优雅，只在你倒下的这一刻全然尽失。
到了这一步哪里还有傲可言，明明是各种意义上的“傲娇娇娇娇娇娇娇娇”，而这也只是终末地让你记住这个少女的第一步。
如果终末地写傲娇只依靠“八嘎无路赛”、不满表情这类路径依赖，其实还是差点儿意思，毕竟不太能照应游戏此前展露出的人文调性。
于是你能看到，终末地这次写人时用到了一种“巧劲儿”，将“傲娇”作为一种气质内核，融入到了游戏的布景与叙事之中，用中式风格诠释了这种经典的人设。
当我回顾这次 「丹青渡」 给我留下的种种印象，最为深刻的就是萦绕其间的中式浪漫，比如借物喻人、睹物思人，这些国内玩家从小念到大的描写手法。
——这可能听起来有点语文课本，但如果你体验了这些内容，应该确实会有类似的既视感。就好像前几个版本中，春和景明又磅礴大气的武陵，象征着庄方宜的温婉与坚韧；千疮百孔的北部禁区，也代表着李织烟亟需被修复的内心……一座城、一片景都是人物内心的写照。
「丹青渡」版本的故事，基本都发生 在祀的家，这也给了我们另一个视角去一窥她性格上的反差。
等的就是这雷霆大白字（童趣真诚版本）
这恰好落在了终末地内容产出的优势区——高规格的场景设计与国风表达。
比如初见画卷之时，我第一时间想到的故事是“桃花源记“。再次与祀正式见面时，只见她静坐于画卷之上，然后似仙子一样向你飘来，将你领入悬挂于山巅之上的画中境。

news.title: B社开发八年做不出来的无缝《星空》，玩家借助AI半年就搞定了
news.summary: "The modders will fix it." 众所周知，贝塞斯达历经大约八年时间开发的科幻RPG大作《星空》，在发售后很长一段时间里都饱受玩家的诟病——除了探索内容、任务设计上的争议，还有一个很重要的原因，就是作

content.v: https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14507/f37ee21288e43e707710a256d43fcbbf.appmsg_mw680water
"The modders will fix it."
众所周知，贝塞斯达历经大约八年时间开发的科幻RPG大作《星空》，在发售后很长一段时间里都饱受玩家的诟病——除了探索内容、任务设计上的争议，还有一个很重要的原因，就是作为一款2023年发售的游戏，《星空》的地图无缝程度实在有些跟不上时代。
受限于Creation Engine 2的“祖宗之法”，《星空》进出建筑要读条，跨星系旅行要读条，甚至有时连爬个梯子都得读条，游戏体验总被各种黑屏和加载画面切得七零八落。
尤其扫兴的是，飞船不能无缝降落。
玩家可以花几个小时装点自己的飞船，却不能亲手驾驶这艘精心装修的钢铁巨兽，穿过大气层、停到眼前的星球上。你能做的只有打开地图，选择落点，然后把接下来的旅程交给加载画面。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14507/a8958451b4476ce9c4c98fa5f4728f53.appmsg_mw680water
早在2022年，陶德·霍华德就在接受IGN采访时解释过，团队很早便决定将地表与太空作为两套独立的场景处理。在他看来，为两者之间的过渡投入大量开发时间，对玩家而言并没有那么重要，团队更希望把地表和太空各自的体验做好。
只是，对于已经在《无人深空》之类的游戏里习惯了自由起降的玩家来说，这番解释多少有些扫兴：都让我探索宇宙了，怎么从天上飞到地上，反而成了一项不太重要的功能？
然而，终于有人弥补了贝塞斯达11年都没做成的事情。近日，MOD开发者Frederik Wessberg公开了其MOD“Seamless Landings”的演示：
飞船从太空接近行星，进入大气层，穿过云层，再一路下降到地表，整个过程不再弹出熟悉的加载画面。
目前，这款免费MOD仍在开发，尚未公布上线时间。作者明确表示，他一个人花了约半年，借助AI工具的辅助，把MOD制作到了可以公开演示的程度。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14507/51ed2b3367616e0dfdac56e652858329.appmsg_mw680water
作者介绍，自动下降期间，玩家可以离开驾驶座，在船内自由走动，或者找个位置看风景。他还表示支持手动飞行，玩家可以在低轨欣赏行星，也可以向地表下降，甚至把飞船停到水面上。
按他的解释，原版《星空》从太空看行星时，主要呈现的是地表贴图、可能存在的云层和大气效果。这套表现只能玩家远远看见一颗星球，如果强行飞过去，就会撞上视觉表现的边界（之前有人也在原版里“破限”尝试过，最终就是让飞船“亲”到了贴图）。
所以，他重新实现了太空中的三维行星渲染，让行星在不同高度都能呈现足够清晰的细节。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14507/4b2bcf2966e77bf9441f581e24a098de.appmsg_mw680water
这款MOD的实现原理是，飞船下降到一定高度后，系统会锁定目标地表区域，并暂时接管手动驾驶。接下来，地表资源在后台加载；准备完成后，再执行一次场景切换。作者称，这一步约需130毫秒，通过云层或再入特效遮蔽。
换句话说，玩家体验到的是一段连续的下降过程，背后仍有一次经过精心安排的交接。云层确实是新的三维云层，同时也帮引擎挡住了换场景时的动作。
Wessberg在Reddit帖子中称，自己本职就是软件开发者，平时工作和MOD项目都会使用AI辅助。他认为，独自半年做到目前的程度，离不开AI工具的帮助，尤其是对引擎的逆向分析。但即便如此，项目也已经花掉了数百小时，连他自己都不太敢细算。
但——无论如何，一位MOD开发者借助AI，花了半年时间，已经拿出了看得见的成果。反观历时八年开发、发售后又更新了三年的《星空》，玩家至今还得在降落前等待读条。
陶德哥哥，你看看人家呢？
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14507/a3846841d5db6e6cff16cb00941b0c57.gif_mw680

news.title: 英伟达RTX Spark实测：深度集成AI Agent的轻薄本，将如何改变游戏业？
news.summary: 一周前的微软发布会上，当英伟达CEO和微软CEO一起介绍RTX Spark时，我脑海中浮现的一句话是“它改变了Windows”。 在他们的对话里，RTX Spark并不是在说某一代硬件能有多快、显卡性能有多强，更像是Wi

content.v: 一周前的微软发布会上，当英伟达CEO和微软CEO一起介绍RTX Spark时，我脑海中浮现的一句话是“它改变了Windows”。
在他们的对话里，RTX Spark并不是在说某一代硬件能有多快、显卡性能有多强，更像是Windows的下一种可能：当AI模型直接在个人电脑上运行，当智能体能够在保护隐私的情况下执行本地任务，PC能发展到哪一步。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14510/982dcc348784a9ece74a532009c4e93e.appmsg_mw680water
英伟达CEO黄仁勋（左）和微软CEO Satya Nadella（右）
只不过，对于我们普通玩家来说，RTX Spark的特点会来得更加简单粗暴——它在一台轻薄本的机器上，用一颗超级芯片就集成出了性能相当于笔记本版RTX 5080的GPU。
不管从哪方面来说，RTX Spark都让我对它充满了好奇，也对它的实机性能“几分还原”充满期待。终于在几天前，我拿到一台实机后，就立马对它的各方面性能进行了测试。
这次我拿到的，是“华硕ProArt创16 RTX Spark”。它是华硕首批搭载NVIDIA RTX Spark N1X超级芯片的AI智能体轻薄本，我这台搭配的64GB统一内存，由CPU与GPU共享。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14510/2cad94b29abf82029ac2c2777ed39c72.appmsg_mw680water
共享的统一内存，正是RTX Spark和过去x86架构PC的最大不同。在NVIDIA RTX Spark N1X中，基于ARM架构的CPU和Blackwell架构RTX GPU被整合在同一套SoC中，也就可以使用同一套内存。
对于AI相关工作来说，这种设计的意义尤为重大。因为大模型往往需要占用大量内存，统一内存可以让CPU与GPU更灵活地访问模型数据，避免性能因为显存溢出而大幅下降的尴尬情况。
在这台电脑上，我用Artificial Analysis AgentPerf Local和llama.cpp进行了简单的本地模型部署测试，并使用Qwen3.8-27B-Q4_K_M作为模型。
在面对简单的日常对话时，模型都几乎秒答，处理日常任务绰绰有余。不过随着输入文本量的增大，本地模型的响应速度也会明显变慢。
例如在面对16k tokens级别的内容时——也就是一篇长论文的任务量时，模型用了约28秒才开始回复我，总共花费78秒完成回答；等到内容量增加到64k tokens级——你可以看做是丢给了模型一本电子书，本地模型花了140秒才开始回复我，并且用了3分钟才回答完我的问题。
如果对大型任务进行拆分，本地模型的响应速度依然在可接受范围内。当然更重要的是，这是个在断网状态中照用不误的智能体，解决了很多人使用AI智能体的最大忧虑，隐私问题。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14510/c1c0e366732f089cd16a72bb24f0f81e.appmsg_mw680water
而对于我们游戏党来说，这个共享内存池同样是一大优势。它不仅能为游戏运行提供更灵活的内存资源调配，也使得NVIDIA在PC游戏领域积累的大量技术优势能进一步发挥出来，比如我们熟知的路径追踪、DLSS 5与Reflex等。
这次在ProArt 创16 RTX Spark上，我总共测试了《赛博朋克2077》《毁灭战士：黑暗时代》和《漫威争锋》这三款游戏的实机表现。
其中《赛博朋克2077》作为“画质测试游戏”，在4K分辨率、光线追踪低预设、DLSS 平衡模式和3倍多帧生成下，平均帧数为134左右，1%Low为95FPS。放在同级别的笔记本独显中，这个表现已经接近RTX 5080；
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14510/e6bd910302afca97ee70cabe82343c81.appmsg_mw680water
4K画质的《毁灭战士：黑暗时代》，则可以在中画质预设、DLSS平衡模式和3倍多帧生成下，平均帧数达到140左右，1%Low能稳定到100FPS。
值得一提的是，《漫威争锋》为这次测试提供了专门的ARM版本。在这个版本下，游戏可以在4K高画质预设、DLSS平衡模式和3倍多帧生成的环境中，达到145左右的超高FPS。只不过由于其高速动作属性，1%Low帧会在团战这样的复杂场景中掉到90FPS。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14510/e0d7a9e3e198df48dc06f77869760b0c.appmsg
之所以着重提一下《漫威争锋》为ARM版本，是因为如果一定要为ARM架构PC找点不足，那一定是它的兼容问题。
因为目前大部分PC仍旧采用x86架构，这就注定还有大量软件和游戏仍需要以兼容模式在ARM架构的PC上运行。它们的性能表现和稳定性，势必会成为未来亟待解决的首个问题。
只不过以现在搭载RTX Spark的PC表现来看，定位为轻薄本、却能有如此强大的游戏性能，同时也能满足AI工作者的创作需求，ARM架构在PC上的普及或许会越来越快。
等到这时候，就算玩家们自己不去问，游戏厂商们也会快速跟进各大游戏的ARM原生版本——毕竟用户的需求才是第一生产力。
英伟达也表示，RTX Spark上市即支持上百款游戏和DLSS 5，包括: 《明日方舟：终末地》《控制：共振》《赛博朋克 2077》《堡垒之夜》《战争机器：事变日》《霍格沃茨之遗》《漫威争锋》《永劫无间》《NBA 2K27》《异环》《鸣潮》。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14510/9e5c4b16f7a271c0e54d36361983b3db.appmsg_mw680water
RTX Spark的诞生，或许也是源自于此。当它创造出足够多的使用场景，也给了用户足够多的选择，一台高性能Windows PC能做什么就不再只是老黄在舞台上畅谈的那些。
它最终能否真的改变Windows，还需要由这些电脑走进用户日常生活后的表现来回答。

news.title: 十年之后，重新认识这款火遍全球的中国游戏
news.summary: 十年，从爆款到长青。 本周，五名缅甸选手在一件亚运会纪念衫上签下了自己的名字，还写下了给中国音数协游戏博物馆的祝福。 两周前的爱知·名古屋亚运会上，正是这五位选手以4比0击败印尼队，拿下了《Mobile Legends:

content.v: https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14506/b5fe7a2ab30791be8f0677b6bc79e1cd.appmsg_mw680water
十年，从爆款到长青。
本周，五名缅甸选手在一件亚运会纪念衫上签下了自己的名字，还写下了给中国音数协游戏博物馆的祝福。
两周前的爱知·名古屋亚运会上，正是这五位选手以4比0击败印尼队，拿下了《Mobile Legends: Bang Bang》（MLBB）项目的金牌，这是MLBB首次作为正式奖牌项目亮相亚运会。同时，该项目也以超过82万的峰值同时观看人数，成为本届亚运会电竞项目中收视最高的赛事。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14506/a7778146af878ef406abb6a6d2c4a515.appmsg_mw680water
与冠军签名衫一同被收藏到游戏博物馆的，还有MLBB五届世界赛的手办、一件巴迪衫、制作人签名的十周年纪念册，以及Team Spirit战队的签名手机与赛事服——这家电竞观众熟悉的老牌俱乐部在2024年组建了MLBB战队，今年这支队伍代表东欧与中亚赛区在电竞世俱杯（Esports World Cup）上夺冠，成为MLBB全球大赛历史上首支来自东南亚之外的冠军。
一款中国公司做的游戏成为比赛项目，然后俄罗斯与德国班底的战队在法国赢得冠军，缅甸选手在亚洲最高的赛场上赢得金牌，然后这些冠军的签名物件又将被送回中国的游戏博物馆，这无疑是一个非常国际化的场景。而在它背后，这款游戏早已连接上亿用户，从东南亚出发，跨越中东、欧洲和南美，又在去年年初以《决胜巅峰》之名正式回到了中国市场。
这款由上海沐瞳科技研发的MOBA手游，走过了一条无法复制的十年之路。十年间，这款游戏已经成长为覆盖全球超过220个国家和地区、拥有庞大玩家社区的全球化游戏产品。
在MLBB的十周年成绩单里，有一组很直观的数字：全球累计注册用户超过15亿，月活跃用户峰值超过1.1亿。这样的成绩在十年之内是怎样做到的？进入中国音数协游戏博物馆的这批展品，记录了其中一部分答案。
一、从各国联赛，到同一个国际舞台
对于MLBB这样一款游戏来说，竞技是支撑十年运营的关键内容。在本次入馆的展品中，从亚运冠军的纪念衫、世界赛冠军的队服，到五届比赛的纪念手办，都与电竞直接相关。从M3到M7，世界赛辗转于新加坡、印尼、菲律宾和马来西亚，五只手办各自记录了其中一站。
MLBB从2017年就开始布局职业联赛。如果放在几年前，我们来谈MLBB的顶级赛事队伍，首先想到的还是东南亚强队，印尼、菲律宾、马来西亚等地积累了大量玩家与观众，也长期输送着成绩出色的职业队伍与选手。
这份积累至今仍在。今年8月，来自东欧与中亚赛区的Team Spirit以4比3击败缅甸战队Yangon Galacticos，拿下电竞世俱杯上的季中杯MSC冠军。赛后，Team Spirit队员谈到队伍此前就曾专门赴马来西亚集训，与亚洲队伍打训练赛——先到更强的对手身边磨练，再回到国际赛场与他们较量。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14506/112d1dcf3c869ba9f43c2bbfbadd3217.appmsg_mw680water
但与之前不同的是，其他地区开始有了自己的比赛、自己的明星选手，以及自己的冠军。以电竞世俱杯进入决赛的这两支队伍为例，就都不是过去人们熟悉的东南亚强队，而Team Spirit的夺冠，更是直接打破了延续多年的格局：MLBB官方国际顶级赛事的冠军，第一次属于一支欧洲队伍。
本届电竞世俱杯上，MLBB也是唯一拥有女子赛事的项目，最终由法国俱乐部Team Vitality卫冕夺冠。在BBC对女子赛事的选手专访中，一位埃及女牙医Nouthan“白天看牙、晚上电竞”的故事还引发了广泛关注。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14506/ecfee7c5c713332d4e03800eb156b850.appmsg_mw680water
这些新兴赛区的崛起，离不开沐瞳搭建的本地联赛体系。在东欧与中亚，MCC联赛为Team Spirit这样的队伍提供了稳定的竞技环境和成长通道。在拉美，MLBB于2021年在巴西推出职业联赛，到了2024年巴西联赛与拉美南、北区域赛事合并，组成MPL LATAM。巴西战队RRQ Akira拿下首届冠军，Entity7获得亚军，两队分别通过不同路径前往国际赛场。
土耳其的发展则提供了另一种参照。今年的MLBB土耳其锦标赛已经办到第七季，八支参赛队首次全部来自职业俱乐部，名单里除了Aurora、FUT、Eternal Fire，还有足球观众可能会熟悉的土超巨头贝西克塔斯。对一款长期运营的游戏来说，这些国际大赛之外的比赛，同样维系着玩家的关注。
2027年1月，M8世界总决赛的决赛阶段也将前往伊斯坦布尔，这也将是MLBB世界总决赛首次在欧洲举办。M7世界赛的峰值同时观看人数达到约568万，据Esports Charts统计，这是移动电竞赛事的历史最高纪录。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14506/5a0d27cbad27715039bc39714a46a1b6.appmsg_mw680water
从亚运会到电竞世俱杯，再到已官宣入选的电竞国家杯和即将落地伊斯坦布尔的M8，依靠覆盖全球的五大赛区，MLBB同时出现在综合性体育赛事和电竞专业赛事两条赛道上，这在移动游戏中并不多见。
二、走进玩家的日常
入馆的展品中，还有一件巴迪衫，这是一种以Batik蜡染花布制作的民族服装，带着鲜明的印度尼西亚文化特色。这件MLBB限定款由印尼创意经济部推出，将当地的传统服饰与游戏联系在了一起。由一国政府部门推出这样的物品，足以说明游戏在当地的影响力，而顺着这件展品往回看，也能看到MLBB怎样一步步走进当地生活。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14506/82ff50b5bf0de2da64e1f499f70edb39.appmsg_mw680water
身着MLBB限定款巴迪衫的印尼创意经济副部长Irene Umar表示，MLBB为印尼新创意经济注入活力
2016年，正是中国移动游戏行业高速发展之际，沐瞳却首先将目光投向了海外市场。如今看来，这一决策无疑让他们在海外移动MOBA市场占据了先机。但对于当时这支刚成长起来的团队来说，要在海外真正站住脚，还得跨过好几道关。
第一道关是网络本身。相比中国已经成熟的移动互联网环境，许多海外市场的基础设施还远没有那么完善，据沐瞳员工回忆，早年MLBB团队去东南亚做活动时有一项重要工作就是帮玩家装游戏：在现场架好Wi-Fi，安排人手辅助下载，玩家之间也会用蓝牙互传安装包。为了减轻流量负担，团队还找当地运营商谈过专门的游戏流量套餐。
语言是另一道关。MLBB早期的本地化主要交给国内外包，玩家反馈并不理想，后来团队开始找当地玩家和本地人员一起打磨文本，对各语种的支持才逐步完善起来。
对于游戏出海来说，服务器、网络、下载、翻译，这些都有具体而直接的解决办法，但不同地区的文化认同没有现成答案。为了让游戏真正走进当地玩家的世界，MLBB团队做了一件持续多年的事：在英雄角色的设计中融入各国的历史与民间传说，而且不仅依靠开发团队的创作，也让当地玩家和创作者深度参与。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14506/012ffcfbb7c945fc4f8b41f06b30ad50.appmsg_mw680water
比如，MLBB里有一个角色叫迦多铎卡伽（Gatotkaca），原型出自印尼民间流传的《摩诃婆罗多》演绎版本。游戏最终采用的形象，出自印尼漫画家Is Yuniarto的作品《Garudayana》。而这个形象的诞生，是从玩家投票开始的：玩家先选出希望加入的英雄，再选定采用哪个版本，之后游戏团队才找到漫画家，邀请他参与角色和招式草图的绘制。
当地玩家和创作者的参与，不仅能保证角色足够本土化和大众化，也能吸引更多当地玩家。这样的角色，在MLBB的英雄名单里还有不少，比如巴当取材于马来西亚民间传说中的大力士，服饰里也融入了Batik蜡染元素。今年8月，巴当还出现在吉隆坡的一场由苹果公司举办的Today at Apple创意工坊里，当地街头艺术家Cloakwork带着参与者，围绕MLBB英雄进行涂色创作。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14506/4a6ff72c0bc0cd8ebdcdb7aefadc92dd.appmsg_mw680water
类似的共创在更大范围内也在发生。今年五月，沐瞳在全球范围内举办了一场游戏皮肤设计挑战赛，评委请来了《战锤40K》概念艺术家Adrian Smith和《守望先锋》首席概念艺术家Ben Zhang等大咖。
比赛要求参赛者手绘一整套五人皮肤系列，并明确禁止使用AI，十周之内，来自20多个国家和地区的1300多名创作者报名，最终提交了500多件作品，冠军是一位葡萄牙创作者，获奖名单里还有众多来自英国、哈萨克斯坦、菲律宾、白俄罗斯和蒙古的作品。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14506/c11a3d959d75c34c385fb39a910be374.appmsg_mw680water
葡萄牙创作者TaissOnAir的参赛作品《The Heraion Cup》，完成度非常高
风格契合的创作者甚至可以直接通过专门的通道入职沐瞳，获奖设计也有机会被做进游戏，出现在全球玩家的对局里。
三、十周年，十个国家
这个十月，世界各地的玩家开始在线下给MLBB过生日。
10月9日至11日，MLBB的十周年庆典在全球十个国家展开，吸引数万名玩家到场，庆祝的方式各不相同。莫斯科的聚会放在一座美食商场，玩家可以与Cosplayer合影，和创作者互动，也可以去1对1的对局区，找人当面打一局。平时只在屏幕上关注的人，也有机会在这里见上一面。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14506/7a8ab0c84a56437412a9e0da2240417c.appmsg_mw680water
马来西亚古晋的活动设在Vivacity购物中心，一位发行负责人在接受当地媒体采访时说，他在现场看到了父母和孩子组成一队，与其他玩家对战。
在菲律宾，一辆周年巡游卡车从10月8日到11日，在大马尼拉地区的不同地点停留。主会场设在达义市的Market! Market!，玩家不仅能在那里参与活动，也可以沿着卡车的路线找一站加入。会场里还有一座大型蕾拉装置，玩家伸手与她击掌，现场灯光就会亮起，拍下的画面随即投影出来。
在伊斯坦布尔，玩家可以在博斯普鲁斯海峡边与MLBB十周年装置合影，身后就是连接欧亚两岸的大桥。一艘MLBB主题游艇则载着创作者和玩家一同穿越海峡。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14506/5e3c359ee09cfef02e2ef205b2d0fdfd.appmsg_mw680water
在印度，庆典甚至开进了火车站。豪拉车站的10号站台换上了蕾拉主题，一列披着十周年涂装的专列，从加尔各答开往普里。
在秘鲁的Jockey Plaza购物中心，游戏里的领主和防御塔则被搬到了线下，观众可以直接参与击杀挑战。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14506/5aa2ca662b8e5531a1887f1e97dd54d9.appmsg_mw680water
曼谷夜市里搭起了8米高的生日蛋糕装置，里面还藏着供玩家互动的扭蛋机。缅甸街头有近50名Coser参加主题巡游。马来西亚则以133名Coser开场齐舞，让游戏当时已有的133位英雄在线下聚齐。老战队Saiyan也重新登场，MPL冠军SRG则和玩家打起了水友赛。台上既有游戏里的熟悉面孔，也有这些年在赛场上留下名字的人。

十周年之外，MLBB早已通过各种合作走进这些国家的玩家日常。在菲律宾，今年的一个标志性案例是与国民快餐品牌Jollibee的联名。这家菲律宾最大的快餐连锁，第一次把自己的蜜蜂吉祥物送进了MLBB的对局——以一个“WOW BIDA”战斗表情的形式，玩家可以在比赛中使用。合作还延伸到了线下：在菲律宾多个城市的Jollibee门店，MLBB举办了联合活动，把快餐和手游这两个菲律宾人日常生活里最高频的场景连接在了一起。
几乎同一时期，2000年代通过电视综艺走红的歌舞组合SexBomb Girls也与MLBB合作，把歌曲《Halukay Ube》改编成了游戏主题MV，招牌动作“Get, Get, Aw!”则变成了对局中可以使用的战斗表情。成员Rochelle在采访中提到，很多年轻观众是通过这次合作第一次认识她们——一个千禧年代的流行符号，借由一款手游重新回到了年轻人面前。
结语
十年做一件事，到底留下了什么？游戏博物馆展柜里的MLBB十周年纪念册、赛事手办、巴迪衫与冠军签名物件，意味着过去十年的经历已经成为可以被记录和回顾的历史。对玩家而言，这些展品关联的是自己的生活与记忆；对产业而言，它们记录了一款中国游戏与海外市场逐步建立联系的过程。
而在博物馆之外，MLBB新的十年已经开启。
这次周年庆期间，沐瞳核心团队和MLBB开发团队的多名成员也来到庆典当地与玩家面对面交流。除了游戏体验，双方还聊到了社区建设、未来内容规划，以及玩家对接下来的MLBB有什么意见和期待。

制作人Roger谈到下一阶段时，仍然把打磨游戏体验和倾听不同市场玩家的声音放在最前面。在这次见面会上，他也提到，过去十年，全球玩家通过社区反馈、内容创作和电竞参与，持续影响着游戏的发展方向。对于这款已经运营十年的游戏，Roger提出了一个更具体的目标：“对我们来说，真正有挑战、也最有意义的事情，不只是让更多新玩家加入，而是到了十年之后，依然能够为那些从2016年就开始陪伴MLBB的老玩家，带来足够新鲜、足够精彩的游戏乐趣”。
也许再过十年，游戏博物馆的展柜里还会多出一些新的展品，只是不知它们会从哪个国家或是赛场上被带回来。

news.title: 一款赛车游戏要做到什么样，才有机会冲击年度游戏？
news.summary: 如果一个赛车游戏里的剧情需要主角输掉一场比赛，开发者该怎样设计才能让玩家更容易接受？ 对于玩赛车游戏比较多的人来说，这个问题本身可能就有点反常识——毕竟大部分赛车游戏几乎就不存在什么“剧情”，背景故事和NPC角色更多时候

content.v: https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14505/f84793b01ed019e0d959d0b84f15f04c.appmsg_mw680water
如果一个赛车游戏里的剧情需要主角输掉一场比赛，开发者该怎样设计才能让玩家更容易接受？
对于玩赛车游戏比较多的人来说，这个问题本身可能就有点反常识——毕竟大部分赛车游戏几乎就不存在什么“剧情”，背景故事和NPC角色更多时候只是起到串场的作用。
但计划于2027年发售的《离合：红线》（《Clutch》），立志于成为一款特立独行的“电影级开放世界动作飙车游戏”。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14505/fd9d548a1a47871b5cd164e46c9cb8e4.appmsg_mw680water
该作由Maverick Games开发。这家工作室成立于2022年，多名主创来自Playground Games，曾在《极限竞速：地平线》系列的开发团队中担任重要职务。
游戏的舞台设在摩纳哥和法国蔚蓝海岸。Cass与Theo是一对想要参与职业赛事的车手兄妹，同时也会卷入地下赛车世界，经历追逐、逃亡，以及围绕家庭、竞争和背叛展开的故事——你可以把这理解为一场有些类似于《速度与激情》那样的汽车动作电影，并由玩家亲自来参与其中的驾驶环节。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14505/5de134f8222711cef5de20ade4aac8a5.gif_mw680
《离合：红线》也登陆了黄金周期间在上海举办的RED LAND，在现场搭建了一个维修区氛围的展台，来排队体验的玩家不少。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14505/30d093eab9140d1d655fd8e2eba6214d.appmsg_mw680water
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14505/ac6397c68aef570989527696ddfdac94.appmsg_mw680water
工作室联合创始人Mike Brown和Ben Penrose也来到了现场，二人分别担任《离合：红线》的创意总监和美术总监。Mike此前也是《极限竞速：地平线5》的创意总监。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14505/0f511ba18f5bdd1fe52a2502a95a498b.appmsg_mw680water
Mike（左）和Ben（右）在RED LAND的现场交流会上分享开发经历
在交流中Mike提到，就连他也对《速度与激情》系列在中国的火爆人气有所耳闻，《离合：红线》里同样会有一些大场面，包括赛场事故、被警察追逐时从窗户翻身跳出等等——但整体上会符合现实里的物理规律。
在Mike看来，后期的《速度与激情》已经有些像超级英雄电影，多米尼克几乎成了“车界超人”。当观众知道角色怎么都不会出事，危险感反而消失了：“但Theo只是个比较厉害的车手，没有超能力。”
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14505/b9c7605eba802eadfd6fc8a444f2956e.appmsg_mw680water
游戏里也将有不少车外的场景
他们参考的电影也不止《速度与激情》。Ben说，团队经常租电影院的影厅，一起看《雷霆壮志》（Days of Thunder）、《布利特》（Bullitt）、《极速车王》（Ford v Ferrari）等作品。团队中负责灯光和过场动画的成员，还针对性地研究了赛车电影中由真实摄影带来的镜头畸变、色差，再结合到他们的游戏中。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14505/439ac7512c5b8927e494edcc6f029080.appmsg_mw680water
《极速车王》（Ford v Ferrari）海报
该作的编剧Jamie Brittain更是来自影视行业，曾是人气英剧《Skins（皮囊）》的主要编剧。Ben提到，是Jamie主动联系了工作室——因为他本人非常喜欢游戏，对这个行业的了解甚至超过一些业内开发者。
Jamie带来的主要帮助，是将游戏中的人物写得更完整、细腻，避免刻板化。比如Cass与Theo虽然是兄妹，也有竞争，还要面对各自的社会关系。要在游戏中将这些复杂的情感描写得足够可信、让玩家愿意关心，需要过硬的笔力。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14505/20d033147da517e37b24e086298efe55.appmsg_mw680water
Cass与Theo
同时，编剧越认真地处理人物关系，就越容易遇到赛车游戏特有的麻烦。
正如文章开头提到的：Jamie有几次认为剧情需要玩家输掉比赛，或者必须拿第二名，有时则是必须赢下这一场。但最终，Mike在这件事上收回了一部分决定权，坚持比赛结果只能由玩家的水平决定。
Mike说：“如果我们强行让玩家拿第一或第二，那么当他下一次拿第一时，他会想：这是因为我的技术好，还是因为游戏让我赢？”
同样，他也提到《离合：红线》没有为了追求“电影感”而随意插入过场动画：“玩家来玩一款赛车游戏就是想开车，每次让他停下手上的操作，就必须给一个足够好的理由。像是争吵、爆炸或是其他足够戏剧性的时刻。”
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14505/7095f59be2e1fa4ceb4a3a2a7e87d753.gif_mw680
Mike承认，这一点真做起来比预想中还要难。工作室成立第一天，他只用大约三分钟就讲完了预想中的故事大纲，后来才逐渐更清晰地意识到，要在几十小时里让剧情和角色持续发展，还得有转折和悬念，需要投入的规划和工作比预期中更加庞大。
除了想要提供电影级叙事，《离合：红线》还是一款开放世界游戏，主要舞台设置在摩纳哥——作为蒙特卡洛拉力赛和摩纳哥大奖赛的举办地，这里有着浓厚的赛车文化积淀，同时也是度假胜地。
Ben曾反复询问团队成员：“如果有人把超级跑车的钥匙交给你一天，你想开到哪里？”最常见的回答是“那些道路漂亮、转过弯就能看见壮丽景色的地方”——摩纳哥就是这样一个地方。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14505/3ca3f46271a2bd4fac8ef65a54de8506.gif_mw680
《离合：红线》游戏实机画面
摩纳哥的地形实际给游戏的开发增添了不少难度。城市坐落在山坡上，玩家能从高处俯瞰建筑，所以建筑的屋顶都得完整制作，还不能太重复；此外玩家还可能经常从上方道路冲出去，落到下面某处，开发者也必须考虑那样的情况还能否正常行驶。
Ben曾担任《极限竞速：地平线》系列的美术总监。他说他记得以前开发时曾有人会问：玩家以每小时一百英里的速度驶过，环境细节有必要做到这个程度吗？但他认为，如果希望玩家投入这个世界，这些细节就很重要。同时他也坚持：做开放世界，那么玩家看到远处的地点，就应该能开过去，而不是靠贴图遮掩出来的一条固定赛道。
在《离合：红线》的开发过程中，团队贯彻了这一点。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14505/b3d86f4f2402171c9024c821ed24a44a.gif_mw680
游戏里也有着颇为复杂立体的城市场景
总之不难感受到，真要做出一款“电影级开放世界动作飙车游戏”，挑战确实不少。项目组愿意如此投入，也与他们给自己设定的目标有关：Mike也曾公开提到过，希望《离合：红线》能够竞争TGA的年度游戏奖。
这听上去有些大胆，毕竟赛车游戏就和另一些体育类游戏一样，通常被视为一种有着特定受众、不够“全面”的游戏类型，无法代表行业的“顶峰”。
Mike也承认，要让《离合：红线》成为年度游戏很难，团队未必真做得到。但提出这个目标，会让团队里的大家不再只和其他赛车游戏比较，进一步思考世界上最好的游戏是什么、自己的作品怎样才能达到同样的水平。
他举例说，像《双人成行》或是《33号远征队》这样的游戏，即便没有GTA那样的预算，团队整体也没有《塞尔达传说》那样的开发经验积累，但作品仍然能让人感到开发者对一个特定的玩法类型花了很多心思、在这方面有自己的想法和手艺——他希望《离合：红线》也能给玩家这样的感受，让大家感受到开发者对赛车游戏的热爱。
游戏里车辆的外观和内饰都将支持高度自定义
在RED LAND现场，Mike观察到不少试玩者并不熟悉赛车游戏，甚至可能是第一次接触。
《离合：红线》的驾驶系统采用了“Simcade”的定位，大致可以理解为在拟真与街机体验之间寻找平衡，属于较容易上手，但也不是一路摁着加速键就能拿第一的那种，所以赛车游戏新手冲出赛道或原地打转的景象还挺常见的。
现场试玩位
在我试玩时，身边恰好就是几位COS成动漫角色的玩家。当实际试玩者开着车冲出山崖时，引来了周围同伴的欢声笑语，有人说着“让我试试”想接过手柄，被试玩者躲了过去说：“看我再来。”而当剧情演到赛场事故的桥段时，大家又一齐发出“哦呜”的惊叹。
现在不少人会觉得，赛车游戏和格斗游戏有点类似，得非常喜欢这一类型，并愿意投入大量时间练习，才容易玩进去。但我想事实未必如此。正如《离合：红线》在不少地方让我想起了曾经的《极品飞车》系列——对国内许多90后玩家来说，赛车游戏恰恰是接触电子游戏的起点之一。
说来，《离合：红线》这一趟中国行的幕后，也有着DENMU Editions的支持——这是投资基金DENMU旗下负责营销与联合发行业务的部门， 我们之前就有过相关报道 ：DENMU的理念是“帮助艺术家在全球打造标志性游戏”，此前小高和刚的《百日战纪》就有其投资并直接推动面向玩家的沟通与交流活动。
作为曾经的“枪车球”三大游戏类型之一，赛车游戏如今的道路却好像有点“越走越窄”。所以开放世界也好，电影化也好，这个类型此刻所需要的，或许正是一款能创造更多理由，让更多人愿意来从零体验驾驶乐趣的“标志性游戏”。

news.title: 《雾锁王国》把生存建造的“不可能三角”填平了
news.summary: 就在今天，主打生存动作RPG的《雾锁王国》正式迎来了1.0版本。这款游戏最早在2024年初上线过抢先体验，后续一直维持着不错的人气，上线8个月就突破了300万销量。 如果你一直有关注SOC游戏板块，大概率会对这款作品印象

content.v: https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14509/92280c1cbcd40ff4d463748e9ecf997b.appmsg_mw680water
就在今天，主打生存动作RPG的《雾锁王国》正式迎来了1.0版本。这款游戏最早在2024年初上线过抢先体验，后续一直维持着不错的人气，上线8个月就突破了300万销量。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14509/742d6a16fbcca74d0c878de306e06e04.appmsg_mw680water
如果你一直有关注SOC游戏板块，大概率会对这款作品印象深刻，毕竟只看更新频率，很难相信《雾锁王国》是一款没有内购、没有赛季通行证的买断制游戏——过去两年半开发商Keen Games推出了八次体量庞大的大型更新。
到这次1.0正式版内容更是丰富。爱好探索的玩家不仅有一整个新的生态区，可以前往全新的浮空岛群落“余烬摇篮”，人物和装备的阶级跟着提高了上限，可以刷的东西更多了，外加主线剧情也有了完整的最终章……
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14509/285c7ed755660164a1e36c6634ecf685.appmsg_mw680water
按照我之前的存档推算，《雾锁王国》至今已累积了超300小时的游玩深度。
于是你能看到在官方更新预告的评论区里，最高赞的几条留言都是感叹：“这游戏更新频率和内容简直离谱，像网游一样勤快，这真是一个单机游戏该有的更新速度吗？”
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14509/df35e03d61d7f60594e4f1c883df91d3.appmsg_mw680water
作为对照，生存建造赛道的另一位老前辈《英灵神殿》，刚刚在上个月结束了长达五年半的抢先体验。这样来看，《雾锁王国》追平从EA到完整版的开发进度，只用了前辈一半的时间。
不过对于生存建造游戏来说，大家也并不是想看谁更新得快， 真正让《雾锁王国》在今天站稳品类头部的核心原因，可能还是其解决了多人联机生存RPG长期以来的“分流困境”。
至少在我的印象中，生存建造游戏都面临着一个很难调和的矛盾：硬核生存、RPG成长与沙盒建造，三者在玩家体感上往往还挺互相打架的。简单来说，很多作品都想兼顾这三种方向，但最后总有一部分做得很糙，成了劝退式短板。
现在想来，我和朋友之所以能在《雾锁王国》里连续泡上百个小时，很大程度上是因为《雾锁王国》在“生存”与“RPG”之间找到了自己的平衡点。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14509/f9ae63c484509152df1668c194ab23b2.appmsg_mw680water
比如不用严苛的饥饿致死惩罚去按头逼玩家，食物和休息其实是增益Buff——吃得好、睡得香，耐力和生命上限就高，你就算不吃不喝，也不会原地暴毙。
这种“做加法而非做减法”的设计，极大地降低了日常维护的挫败感和繁琐。其实提到Buff，如果你有过《魔兽世界》这类传统MMORPG或老派欧美RPG的经验，上手《雾锁王国》会感到一种久违的亲切感，至少更容易接受“吃好喝好”的意义。
另一方面，《雾锁王国》也确实有一套ARPG框架，比如做出了坦克、游侠、战法等清晰的职业分化。你可以和朋友像打团本一样凑齐“战法牧”下地牢、开荒高难度的空荡礼堂、刷词条装备。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14509/2a9bcf26db0b6f4c9f1036fbd412ffff.gif_mw680
1.0版本中的一个关键更新就是战斗系统。以变化最大的法师为例，不仅法杖加入了蓄力重击、闪避反击与空中连段，这次官方一口气塞进了9种包含控场与AOE的全新法术，甚至允许死灵法师流派主动召唤骷髅大军。
对于喜欢战斗的刷子玩家来说，它的成长曲线和构筑深度，完全能当成一款正统动作RPG来玩。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14509/443df7bd79530c58875b9f31ab79ae9b.gif_mw680
当然，只是把MMORPG的刷本套路搬进开放世界，市面上不乏替代品。《雾锁王国》目前真正的护城河，是基于自研引擎打造的体素建造系统。
我记得早在EA阶段，社区里就一直有人把《雾锁王国》称为“高配版MC”。主要是《雾锁王国》里从一块砖石到整座山体，全是由体素构成的。和其他SOC游戏相比，整个游戏在建造系统上的自由度明显要高不少。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14509/296f040abcfbbc3ab4a6ce05eb68df0d.appmsg
可以实现非常精细的风格化布局
如今到了1.0版本之后，“高配版MC”这句话还真不像玩笑话了。 这次1.0最核心的更新之一则是逻辑电路系统，你可以把它理解为类似MC的红石电路。
像这种赋予建筑“动态交互与玩法规则”的更新，带给社区的可能性不言而喻。例如手搓出全自动化的感应门和灯光系统，还能设置陷阱、计时器等机关，个中的创意接近涌现式的。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14509/5844cb4ca5cc84b351c394dc71ced68a.gif_mw680
玩家自此可以自创关卡了，代表着更丰富的UGC生态
怎么说呢，这大概就是“货比货得扔”吧，其他同类游戏还在靠刷数值延长寿命时，《雾锁王国》已经把关卡编辑器交到了玩家手里。
当然，这些内容就属于高阶玩家会去琢磨的内容了。对于我和朋友来说，《雾锁王国》的1.0版本最大的利好，可能还是把“多人联机分工”与“单人独狼推进”的体验融合成了一个整体。
这就要提到我和朋友玩这类联机生存RPG时，一直有个固定的合作模式：往往朋友属于典型的“基建狂魔”，一上线就泡在家里研究建筑结构，我则是坐不住的探索党，负责满世界跑图、打Boss，顺便把搜刮来的稀有建材往家里搬。
但，在很多同类游戏里，这种分工玩到中后期就会脱节——建家的人因为没打Boss解锁不了新图纸，进度就卡在那里了；跑图的人觉得家里修得再好看，充其量也只是个仓库。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14509/9e560663d8a16d9e98a58368d8670b06.appmsg_mw680water
《雾锁王国》里则是依靠拯救工匠NPC来解锁配方，包括家园舒适度还额能带来的超长休息Buff，加上1.0版本移除了所有地图边缘的“未开放区域”空气墙之后，整片薪谷大陆终于彻底融为一体。总之每类玩家都能各取所需。
当然，我们都说SOC游戏最大的门槛是找不到朋友，不过即便是独狼玩家，1.0版本也完全撑得起一段有头有尾、体量扎实的单人冒险。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14509/5162443bf24cef4e9280bfd4dd9aa39d.appmsg_mw680water
顺带一提，制作组这次甚至给散落在世界各地的所有背景笔记、信件和书籍都配了语音，你可以把它们当成有声书塞进播放列表，边跑图边听故事，想想就很有沉浸感。
为什么偏偏是Keen Games这群德国人，能在短短两年半里既保住如此恐怖的更新体量，又没让游戏在系统堆叠中崩盘？
一方面得益于Keen Games此前开发《传送门骑士》攒下的深厚底子，另一方面则是因为他们这次选择了自主发行，开发团队平日也都是泡在Discord和社区里，沟通很畅快。
像是老玩家之前抱怨地图太大、传送点不够用，1.0版本直接把基地的灵火祭坛上限提到了16个，并且干脆允许玩家在最高灵火等级下，能直接深入迷雾区内部建家——主打一个听劝。
也还有一个客观上的技术细节——《雾锁王国》用的是自研引擎。Keen Games当年顶着巨大的研发周期压力自己写引擎，在EA初期确实吃过不少苦头，但到了1.0阶段，过去的技术债已然成了他们最好用的武器。
比如这次更新上，这次在1.0版本中，最直观的体感就是远景地形和大型体素建筑的细节精度大幅飙升，但游戏运行起来反而比以前更流畅了。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14509/97e67d76ddef1ced74554c1ff62b444b.appmsg_mw680water
技术带来的积累也给了Keen Games更宽广的发展前景，随着10月15日1.0正式版同步登陆PC与PS5平台——《雾锁王国》显然站上了一个全新的商业起点。
不过正如Keen Games对外的那样：“1.0是一个里程碑，而不是终点线。”在主线故事告一段落之后，整个工作室依然全员扑在这款游戏上，他们已经开始着手规划2027年乃至更长远的更新。
一家拥有成熟技术底座的团队，愿意用长线服务型游戏的勤勉，去打造一款买断制作品时，它所能爆发出的生命力或许才刚刚开始显现。

news.title: 为了和外星人沟通，我心甘情愿做了两百道理综题？
news.summary: 恋与深……什么，恋与理综？ 起初，朋友在向我推荐解密游戏《深空来信》（The Message from Deep Space）时，一连报了三个菜名：《巴别塔圣歌》加《挽救计划》加《你一生的故事》。 而在被这三个堂堂大名引

content.v: https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14503/d34282344447eb7c5043fa4e5488dff9.appmsg_mw680water
恋与深……什么，恋与理综？
起初，朋友在向我推荐解密游戏《深空来信》（The Message from Deep Space）时，一连报了三个菜名：《巴别塔圣歌》加《挽救计划》加《你一生的故事》。
而在被这三个堂堂大名引来玩了一小时过后，我深感困惑：怎么好像拿了本《华罗庚小学奥数教程》在做？
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14503/64ef4707367aaebb2127c208ec2c5d5c.appmsg_mw680water
《深空来信》是一款需要对电波的游戏——字面意义上的对电波。
游戏背景故事设定在了1973年，一颗“粘”着发信器的陨石降落在了地球，并在持续、规律地广播无线电讯号。而玩家所扮演的破译专家，要天文学家、语言学家和程序员组成一个小型团队，一起破译电波。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14503/cb03d7b872bae9b290fb3b7e471ba784.appmsg_mw680water
最开始，神秘的外星讯号，只是一串串数字。
通过一来一回的数字接龙，破译团队和发信的外星人都确认了，这一来一回的讯号，并不是宇宙中偶发的回音。
在确认了彼此的存在过后，不懂对方的语言，又不能面对面比划，玩家所在的团队就需要不停地猜测外星讯号的含义，并通过回信验证猜测。而在给出了正确的回应后，外星人总会发来一段新来信，由此延伸出新的词汇（就像《挽救计划》里主角和洛基一样）。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14503/4c5747a06fbc40a6f75794852380599d.appmsg_mw680water
如果这样描述破译讯号的基础循环，看起来开头三个硬菜名的印象确实也没什么问题。
但问题是，在大约前10个小时的时间里，玩家面对的，并非关于外星人的种种讯息，而是实实在在的数学运算题。几何、函数、逻辑结束之后，又会引入化学还有物理知识……
这部分题目的数量，总计有二百多道。
在解密内容极为干燥的前提下，游戏的画面还简洁到几乎有些简陋。大多数时间，玩家眼前无非是两台老式显示屏为主的工作台，最生动的场景大概就只有开周会的时候——主管会上蹿下跳地管你问进度。
而会开完了，你还要写周报。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14503/1767f38edd37770175633495086086a4.appmsg_mw680water
还好主管有极强的自我预期管理能力，不然这跟真的上班有什么区别！
鉴于《深空来信》是单人独立首次开发，有一个好点子但一眼看上去又比较单调——这似乎把游戏的上限框在了“极小众”的范畴。
但实际上，上线Steam后，《深空来信》目前的Steam评价为好评如潮，并且评价总数超过了1800条。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14503/71e71f755c61fc840d3f987ba07902e3.appmsg_mw680water
游戏目前还没有官方中文，而Steam评论里，已经有不少简中玩家已将其封为年度最佳。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14503/8b9bef84899fcd36451bedd2cf422134.appmsg_mw680water
乃至GOAT
那么，《深空来信》到底是怎么把人“骗”进来，心甘情愿埋头做理综题的？
《深空来信》从最基础的数学问题入手，其实并不是真的想让人爱上数学。
以游戏中的一次信息上的突破为例，在第175次传输中，玩家会取得一次重大的突破，获得“陨石接收”和“陨石来源”两个有实际含义的词汇。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14503/15f676f56503a412171e759615578b04.appmsg_mw680water
以及输出一条勉强称得上句子的讯息
而这次突破，恰恰是由数学概念牵引出来的。
在破译了一系列运算符号后，外星人发来了勾股定理的公式，引出了图形的概念，再由图形引出线、点，以及点连成线的定理。至此，我们得到了“连接”这个自然语言中也会使用的词汇，并由“连接”的概念，推理出了“陨石”和“信号”这两个词汇。
依次类推，几何中的图形变换，也带出了“起点”、“终点”和“移动”这些词汇，构建起了这次通讯的基础。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14503/3c13dd98245a2eeb06fc16380a566607.appmsg_mw680water
随着传输次数不断增加，游戏中的信息会逐渐从数字、变量等基础概念，不断延伸。最终通过光速等常数， 建立起一套完整的单位制。
于是这两百多次传输，其实是为了构建起了一个可以对话的符号系统。在这之后，外星人的讯号终于可以带来爆炸般的信息增量。
“他们的星球离地球有多远？星球上有多少人口？单个外星人体型有多大？”
除了这些基础信息，从生态系统到进化历程，从科技发展再到意识形态，后期的800多次传输中，玩家和外星人基本上什么都能聊——当然，这是游戏最大的惊喜来源，因此这里不做过多剧透。
之前那些所有看似无意义的数学和科学基础知识，在这一刻终于显露出了自己的意义。这样的“开智”瞬间，确实会给人带来一种智识上的满足，或者说“数学竟然真有用”的感叹。
这其实有点像我们之前介绍过的《穹庐下的魔女》中的桥段，当时的人们通过《几何原本》中看似无用的定理，推算出了地球的直径——即便这可能对当时的人来说也没啥用，但这可是智慧啊！
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14503/3386e09314ea75253c3bc11bbbee5c19.appmsg_mw680water
据开发者Applesinmypants介绍，《深空来信》中从加减乘除开始的谜题设计，灵感其实源自“旅行者金唱片”。
很多人可能都在课本上见过它，知道它随探测器发射升空、携带了人类发送给外星文明的讯息。但大多数人可能都并不了解它运作的原理。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14503/d9da9b1bb56bcc8a200808e7cfe263c3.appmsg_mw680water
就以图片为例，金唱片携带了115幅图像，涵盖从基础科学到日常生活的多个方面，试图让接收者逐步理解地球上的生命和人类社会。
但问题是，外星人要怎么通过唱片来看图片呢？
当然，我们不能指望外星人有台能丝滑读出JPEG、PNG格式的电脑。金唱片选择的方式，是用模拟信号对图片进行了重新编码。
这个过程，可以粗糙地理解成邀请外星人玩解密版拼豆，不过是用物理量的变化，来提示每个点位上应该放上什么信息，最后再拼成一幅完整的图像。
就好比我们用“一”还是“one”来指代数字1是主观的，但光速不管到宇宙的哪个角落都还是一样的。金唱片所使用的，就是这种放之寰宇皆准的物理量作为基础表达。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14503/7a41fc9f422fd6df12b96a3a86c5102e.appmsg_mw680water
在游戏中，外星人利用类似的原理发送了自己的一幅自画像
不光是在图片编码方面，金唱片携带的其它信息，也采用了相似的思路。
例如，唱片外壳上就刻有氢原子的示意图，利用氢原子基态超精细跃迁的特征，定义时间和长度的基本单位；唱片的播放速度，也通过二进制信息与这一时间基准关联起来。
这样来看，《深空来信》其实就是利用了金唱片的原理，邀请玩家来逆向体验：当你作为外星人，接收到了一张“金唱片”，你该怎么一步步破译它。
这一重准确地模拟了星际通讯的机制，解释起来或许显得很有趣，但“现实感”并不一定等于好玩。实际体验中，基础解题仍然有可能是一个略显枯燥的过程。
好在《深空来信》给玩家安排了一个团队，破译讯号的过程中，还有三位科学家一起当牛马。
团队的存在，首先充分发挥了软引导的作用。他们不仅会从自己专长的领域出发，给玩家一点小提示，而且还能在不破坏沉浸感的前提下，让玩家来给自己的翻译对答案。
就像游戏借角色之口说出的那样，你没法指望外星人来“给我们打出一个绿色的大对勾。”于是，《深空来信》选择让科学家的猜想来辅助玩家。章节进行时，如果你编入的词汇与某位科学家完全一致，会得到一两句点评。而章节结束后，每位同事也会就新出现的词汇直接给出自己的猜想。

news.title: 《魔兽世界：永远》如何“挑战极限”，以及发布后会发生什么
news.summary: It's not often one of the biggest games of all time gets a do-over. It's even rarer for a game to get a third

content.v: It's not often one of the biggest games of all time gets a do-over. It's even rarer for a game to get a third attempt. But that, in many ways, is what World of Warcraft: Forever is.

Developer Blizzard is pulling from 22 years of hindsight for what is the third major version of its landmark MMORPG, set to launch on November 4. That two-decade span includes not only the release of 11 WoW expansions, but also the re-release of the original WoW in 2019 and its subsequent "classic" expansions, as well. In the years since WoW Classic's launch, Blizzard has gone from "no changes" to "some changes," taking lessons learned from each Classic release and using them to inform their future work.

With WoW: Forever, Blizzard is finally going beyond replicating history and is instead forging a new vision for its genre-defining MMO, even if that vision is one firmly rooted in the past. GameSpot recently had the chance to talk with Clay Stone, associate production director on WoW: Forever, and Holly Longdale, executive producer and VP for WoW, about how Blizzard approached making a "new" version of original WoW, its approach to Forever's endgame, and what players can expect from Forever's future.
Exceeding Expectations

From the outset, Stone said Blizzard wanted to "push the envelope" and make a big first impression with Forever that went beyond players' expectations. Players certainly had a lot of them. The idea of a new version of WoW Classic that preserved the original game's world but added new content is one that's been around for a long time, and with it all kinds of community ideas of what it should and shouldn't be.

That made it important for Blizzard to deliver not just what players wanted, but go even further, Stone said. Rather than just class-balance changes or the completion of some of WoW's original unfinished quests and zones, as many players likely expected, Blizzard instead went bigger. It created over 1,000 new quests, four new zones, thousands of new items, substantial class changes, multiple new gameplay systems, and even an unexpected playable race not seen in any other version of WoW, Skyborne elves.

"I think that it was important for us to do this up front, to basically not have everything feel like, 'Oh, I predicted that …' and do that now rather than not do that and wait five years down the line," Stone said.
Waiting years to bring a new race or other major additions would be too late, Stone said.

"If there's an opportunity for us to take some bigger swings and some bigger risks up front, I think it sets us up much better for the long-term health of the game and figuring out ways for us to be able to create new surprises for players," he said.

In fact, Blizzard originally planned even more new additions for Forever's launch. Stone said Blizzard scaled some of those plans back as the game got further into development and its announcement at BlizzCon 2026 loomed. Stone teased more new race and class combos than what are currently playable on the game's beta, as well as "more extreme" class changes as seen in WoW Classic's Season of Discovery, could be coming to Forever in the future.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/image_9f78b2.jpeg?w=636

Blizzard is "deliberately holding back just a little" on what's to come, he said. At BlizzCon, it announced a roadmap through Summer 2027 that included new raids, dungeons, and quests, as well as the launch of the game's "Hardcore" permadeath server.

"As we got closer [to BlizzCon], I think we did start to get a lot smarter and go, 'Okay, let's go ahead and draw the line here. You know, this is a lot. This is great for launch.' But it also allows us to save some really good stuff in terms of new content, new dungeons, new raids--things like that--new race/class combos, for not that far after launch," Stone said.
Staying On Azeroth

What some of that new content will be is the subject of wild speculation among the game's passionate community. Stone was adamant the team is committed to "staying on Azeroth" and that there's "a lot of [existing] space [on the original world map] that we already know about and we have plans for."

When asked if Forever would potentially take players to areas outside Azeroth's original two continents of Kalimdor and Eastern Kingdoms, including places seen in other WoW expansions, Stone said the world is a big place and that there are "other locations on Azeroth that are not necessarily Eastern Kingdoms or Kalimdor that we may want to go visit in the future."

"I think that the creative constraint of telling ourselves we're going to stay on Azeroth has created some really cool and interesting creative opportunities for us to explore some places that perhaps players have seen before, and perhaps some places that they haven't seen before," he said.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/image_4c9682.jpeg?w=636

As for what else the future may hold, Blizzard is already surveying the community on potential new classes , which raises the natural question of how Forever will be monetized going forward. The game is included as part of WoW's $15 monthly subscription, as has always been the case with WoW Classic, but for the first time Blizzard is charging $30 for a new race, the Skyborne. While previous WoW expansions have added new races and classes for a price, those expansions have also come with whole new worlds to explore and gameplay systems to master. In the case of the Skyborne, they do come with a new starting zone, but it's hardly an entire expansion's worth of new content.

Longdale said charging for access to the Skyborne was an example of Blizzard "testing things out" and finding a way to "support the team and support the business" without adding "unnecessary barriers" for players accustomed to being able to play WoW Classic with their subscription. It's not necessarily a confirmed business model for how Blizzard will handle the addition of new content in the future, she said. It's also not an indication that Blizzard is planning on "throwing a bunch of new races" into the game, though she said there's "a lot of stuff on the table" when it comes to possibilities.
"It's just something we're trying right now," Longdale said. "We'll see if players like it and if it's a reasonable model going forward."
Launch Is Just The Start

Even as players speculate about Forever's future, there are still plenty of unknowns pertaining to the game's launch. Players have only been able to reach level 30 in the game's beta, and there are still thousands of "secret" items in the game's files yet to be discovered.

Forever's endgame raids will unlock on December 9 for those who have reached level 60 roughly a month after launch, but what those raids will entail, and the items hidden within them, is still a mystery. Unlike in original WoW, where items gained from subsequent raid tiers represented substantial leaps in player power, Stone said Blizzard is aiming to make power progression between raid tiers in Forever "as compact as possible" while still making new raids "fulfilling and desirable."

He said one aspect about WoW Classic the Forever team loves is being able to find powerful, best-in-slot items from endgame dungeons or the world itself. Stone said there are "a lot of opportunities" for that tradition to continue in Forever, and that there are some "unannounced" ideas the team has that aim to keep content like dungeons relevant so that players will want to return to them. Combined with new additions like the Legacy system, an account-wide perk tree that rewards players for leveling up different classes, mastering new professions, and exploring the world, Stone said the intent is for it to never be too late to jump into Forever.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/image_869316.jpeg?w=636

news.title: 随着电影制作工作的开始，《暗黑破坏神 5》即将推出
news.summary: Diablo 5 is still a few years away, but it looks like development is trucking along, now that Blizzard has sta

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/15/d5-1792078974394.jpg
Diablo 5 is still a few years away , but it looks like development is trucking along, now that Blizzard has started filming for its cinematics.

Blizzard cinematic director Neil David Carter posted a photo of the motion capture stage on X / Twitter , simply saying "First shoot #Diablo5." If the cinematic team is just starting motion capture, Diablo 5 probably isn't super late in its development. However, if the cinematic team is shooting motion capture for cutscenes, then the story is mostly fleshed out already.

Luckily, in an interview with Windows Central, senior producer Tiffany Watt confirmed that Diablo 5 would be using its own fork of the Diablo 4 engine, so at least the team didn't have to start building the game from scratch. But in a game like Diablo 5, a lot of work has to go into balance, itemization and world design, and the new game is likely going to be a bit more complicated than Diablo 4 thanks to the procedurally generated maps.
First shoot #Diablo5 https://t.co/3SDU51n3ch

That's why some folks, like former co-founder of Path of Exile developer Grinding Gear Games , are skeptical that Diablo 5 is going to hit its targeted release date. After all, if Diablo 5 does launch in spring 2029, it will come out just shy of six years after Diablo 4. There was an 11-year gap between Diablo 3 and Diablo 4. The gap between Diablo 4 and Diablo 5, if all goes according to plan, will be about half as long. It's little wonder, then, that Blizzard has had to work hard to convince its players that it's not abandoning Diablo 4 early, and that the game will still get content even after Diablo 5 launches .

Only time will be able to tell whether or not Diablo 4 will continue to get updates, or will just get a handful of seasons on repeat like Diablo 3 after Diablo 4 launched. But, really, all we can do is wait and see how everything plays out. For what it's worth, Diablo 5 is shaping up to be a totally different ARPG than its predecessor, and I can't wait to see how the cinematics they're shooting now are going to turn out.

Diablo 5 will tell 'three stories,' including the past, the present desolation of Diablo's takeover, and the future 'terror forming' of Sanctuary. Diablo 5 is set roughly one century after Diablo 4, in a post-apocalyptic timeline where the Lord of Terror himself has already won and rules over a fallen Sanctuary.

news.title: 经过多年的《黑色行动》和《现代战争》，新的《使命召唤》子系列即将推出
news.summary: Activision chief marketing officer Tyler Bahl has confirmed that a new sub-series is on the way for Call of Du

content.v: Activision chief marketing officer Tyler Bahl has confirmed that a new sub-series is on the way for Call of Duty . Modern Warfare 4 is just over a week away from launching (though campaign early access starts tomorrow) and marks the fifth straight year of either a Black Ops or Modern Warfare entry in the franchise. That looks set to change going forward.

Speaking with The Game Business , Bahl elaborated on why Activision won't do back-to-back sequels in the same sub-series . "[The Call of Duty community] wanted something fresh, and even though there were different time settings, and ways to play the game with new features, that tonal shift is something that they were looking for. So, we've already stated that a future title is going to be a new sub-franchise, and we've already laid the groundwork."

Last month, Black Ops developer Treyarch teased that it's working on "something that nobody's ever experienced before." Meanwhile, Sledgehammer Games is reportedly in charge of 2027's Call of Duty , which might also introduce a new sub-series for Call of Duty. The last game in the franchise to not be a Black Ops or Modern Warfare entry was 2021's Vanguard--created by Sledgehammer. So there is precedent there for the studio.

In addition, Activision is now in charge of the Halo franchise . Xbox management is stating that a new team will be spun up for the new Halo game, but it wouldn't be surprising to see a Call of Duty studio being heavily involved.

Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 comes out October 23 on PC, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and Switch 2. Preordering the FPS unlocks campaign early access for tomorrow, October 16, as well as the DMZ mode on October 20.

news.title: GTA 5 似乎将在 GTA 6 发布之前从 PS Plus 中删除
news.summary: One of the biggest games that PlayStation Plus subscribers can play as part of their membership is Rockstar's

content.v: One of the biggest games that PlayStation Plus subscribers can play as part of their membership is Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 5. However, the game will reportedly get yanked from the service soon, just ahead of GTA 6 's release.

People on Reddit say they have received a notification telling them that GTA 5 will be removed for Extra and Premium subscribers on November 17. That is two days before GTA 6 launches on November 19, so the timing certainly suggests Sony and Rockstar are trying to migrate people to the new game.

The notice also includes a link directing people to the preorder page for GTA 6. "Whether you've yet to experience the tale of Franklin, Michael, and Trevor, or want to revisit it before Jason and Lucia's Vice City story begins, now's the time," Sony's notice said.
GTA 5 has rotated in and out of Xbox Game Pass over the years as well, and it is not currently available through the service.

GTA 6 launches on November 19, and the game's steamy launch trailer just arrived . The trailer was stuffed with exciting new details, so be sure to read up on GameSpot's 10 things we noticed from the GTA 6 launch trailer .

news.title: 动视表示《GTA 6》实际上对《现代战争 4》有帮助
news.summary: Rockstar's GTA 6 is releasing this November, and some believe it will blot out the sun when it comes to the im

content.v: Rockstar's GTA 6 is releasing this November, and some believe it will blot out the sun when it comes to the impact it will have on the greater gaming market. The game could also help other titles, like Activision's Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4. That's according to Activision chief marketing officer Tyle Bahl, who said in an interview that GTA 6 will drive more people to gaming overall, and this could act as a rising tide that lifts all ships, including Modern Warfare 4.

“Well, no offense to Zelda, but [GTA and COD] are the two biggest games of the year. And more people coming in to the dashboards, more people taking the dust off their Xbox or PlayStation and playing again, is going to be more eyeballs for us overall," he told The Game Business.
His comment about Zelda is in reference to Nintendo's The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake for Switch 2, which launches on November 5. It's expected to be a huge hit, just like MW4 and GTA 6.

Another publisher, Ubisoft, is not afraid of GTA 6, either. CEO Yves Guillemot said when a big game like GTA 6 comes out, it helps everyone in the industry. One of Ubisoft's biggest games, Rainbow Six Siege, is actually planning to debut new content right around the time GTA 6 launches .

Bahl also stated that a big differentiator for Call of Duty is "spending time with friends," and he thinks this will hold true for MW4 this year even with GTA 6 coming to market just a few weeks after MW4 releases on October 23.

"When we look at our research and say, ‘What is the most exciting things about our games? Is it the gunplay?’ It’s actually spending time with friends. And so, we stand on our own [in that regard]," he said. “If more people are talking about games, if there’s more press around it, that’s going to be good for everybody, not just us.”

MW4's campaign unlocks on October 16 for people who preorder, and the full game--comprising campaign, DMZ, and multiplayer--arrives for everyone on October 23. GTA 6 arrives 27 days later on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/15/small_202610152223488654.png
《塞尔达传说：时之笛》重制版将于11月5日发售，外媒GamesRadar在参加官方试玩活动后表示，本作在保留经典场景与情怀的同时，对画面、镜头和操作体验进行了现代化改造，让海拉鲁世界从未如此鲜活。
试玩中，科奇里森林经过重新设计，环境细节更加丰富，区域边界也显得更加自然。海拉鲁平原的景观表现同样有所提升，隆隆牧场与周围的山丘融为一体，海拉鲁城堡镇则加入了更多环境细节与可进入的建筑，进一步增强了世界的探索感。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/15/small_202610152220559440.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/15/small_202610152220568485.jpg
在玩法设计方面，重制版融入了不少《塞尔达传说：旷野之息》的现代化元素。例如，海拉鲁平原采用了类似的镜头呈现方式，菜单、加载画面和任务提示也与后者的设计风格相近。玩家还可以通过Switch 2 Pro手柄上的按键快速呼出装备界面，在战斗中更方便地切换道具。
GamesRadar认为，这些变化不仅让游戏操作更加流畅，也意味着重制版并非对1998年原作的简单复刻。全程跟随角色肩后的镜头取代了原版部分固定视角，部分隐藏要素因此更容易被发现，整体体验也更加符合当代玩家的习惯。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/15/small_202610152221068746.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/15/small_202610152221067226.jpg
该媒体最后表示，重制版并没有一味追求现代化，而是在保留经典魅力的基础上改善操作与探索体验。对于系列老玩家而言，本作或许不会完全复现当年的游玩感受，但这种面向现代游戏环境的调整反而值得期待。

news.title: 动视:今年最大两款作品是GTA6和COD 无意冒犯塞尔达
news.summary: 近日，动视首席营销官Tyler Bahl在接受《The Game Business》采访时表示，今年真正的两款“最大游戏”是《GTA6》与《使命召唤：现代…

content.v: 近日，动视首席营销官Tyler Bahl在接受《The Game Business》采访时表示，今年真正的两款“最大游戏”是《GTA6》与《使命召唤：现代战争4》，而非外界热议的《GTA6》与《塞尔达传说：时之笛》重制版。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/15/small_202610152215389707.jpg
他直言：“无意冒犯塞尔达，但我认为《GTA6》和《现代战争4》才是今年最大的两款游戏。”
此前，该媒体编辑Chris Dring曾将《GTA6》与《时之笛》重制版比作游戏界的“芭本海默”，认为这两款作品最可能推动新主机销量。但Bahl认为，《现代战争4》同样是拉动玩家回归的重要力量：“更多人打开Xbox或PlayStation，重新开始玩游戏，对我们来说整体上意味着更多关注度。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/15/small_202610152215463876.jpg
Bahl强调，《使命召唤》系列能够历久弥新，核心在于社区与社交体验：“我们调研时问玩家，游戏最吸引人的是战斗还是枪械手感？答案其实是‘我的朋友在’——能和朋友一起玩才是关键。”他还指出，该系列支持跨平台联机，包括今年新加入的Switch 2，这让它拥有独特的竞争优势。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/15/small_202610152217345819.jpg
当被问及《GTA6》11月19日发售是否会导致《现代战争4》玩家数下降时，Bahl表示不一定：“我们拭目以待。实际上可能会略有上升，玩家或许会想‘我可以这个玩一点，那个也玩一点’。”

news.title: Epic和Steam“打起来了”！V社反手更新直接反超
news.summary: Epic近期推出了改版后的Epic Games启动器预览版，并公开强调其性能提升，甚至直接拿竞争对手Steam作比较，宣称新版启动器的启动速度…

content.v: Epic近期推出了改版后的Epic Games启动器预览版，并公开强调其性能提升，甚至直接拿竞争对手Steam作比较，宣称新版启动器的启动速度更快。没想到，Valve很快便通过Steam客户端更新作出回应。
据Epic公布的数据，新版启动器在冷启动状态下进入商店页面仅需5.47秒，而Steam此前需要10.07秒，Epic据此宣称启动速度快了46%。此外，从系统托盘恢复至游戏库页面时，新版Epic Games启动器也比Steam快14%。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/15/small_202610152022496426.png
不过，Valve似乎并不打算就此认输。近日发布的Steam客户端更新带来了多项改进，包括大屏幕模式优化和大量问题修复，其中最引人关注的是客户端启动性能的提升。
有网友分享的视频显示，更新后的Steam客户端启动时间缩短至5.23秒，相较此前的10.07秒几乎缩短了一半，也快于Epic公布的5.47秒。
https://imggif.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/15/origin_202610152023114441.gif
这场启动速度的较量也让两家平台的竞争再次成为焦点。近年来，Epic Games一直试图通过免费游戏等方式吸引玩家，但Steam凭借多年来积累的用户基础和丰富的功能，依然在PC游戏市场占据重要地位。相比之下，Epic启动器在功能完善程度等方面仍被部分玩家认为存在差距。
需要注意的是，上述启动时间来自特定测试及用户分享的视频，实际表现可能受到硬件配置、系统环境和测试条件等因素影响，不能直接代表所有设备上的运行结果。
